OpenSearch Service
This page provides recommendations for using Amazon OpenSearch Service direct queries to
analyze data from CloudWatch Logs, Amazon S3, and Amazon Security Lake. These best practices
help you optimize performance and ensure eﬃcient querying without the need for data ingestion
or duplication.
